overview: World 1 is the main open world: one large island, a chain of small tropical isles and a volcanic island in the far south-east. Players begin in the capital, Aurelia, on the warm southern coast, and difficulty rises the further they travel from it: north into forests, meadows and lakes, east into the desert, north-west through the Ironspine Mountains to the frozen Frosthold Peaks, and finally into the Blightlands and the Emberfall Volcano at the very top of the level range. Fast travel is kept to a handful of waypoints so that most of the world is discovered on foot, by rail, by air or by sea.

zones.Aurelia Heartlands: The safe starting region around the capital: flat green farmland, the river delta and the start of the long southern beach. Every form of travel begins here: the Western and Eastern rail lines, Aurelia Airport and Aurelia Harbor. New players can learn the basics without straying far from the city walls.
zones.Seabreeze Shore: A long, sunny stretch of sand and coastal grass along the south-western coast. The beach town of Seabreeze sits at its heart, linked to the capital by the Coast Road and to Westbrook by Seabreeze Way.
zones.Westbrook Plains: Open, gently rolling grassland along the west coast. It is quiet, roomy country between the western coast and the dense Wildwood, crossed by the Western Line on its way north.
zones.Silverbrook Vale: The river valley north of the capital, where two rivers wind down from the central lake to meet above Aurelia. The Riverside Trail follows the water upstream, and there is no waypoint here, so it is a natural first walk away from the city.
zones.Wildwood: A dense, jungle-like forest in the middle of the island, wrapped around the small central lake and the upper rivers. Visibility is poor under the canopy. The city of Westbrook stands on its south-western edge.
zones.Millbrook Meadows: Wide northern meadows of farmland and windmills that climb toward the snow line, holding the highest ground on the main island. The village of Millbrook is the starting point of the unfinished Frostpass Road.
zones.Eastmere Reach: The green east coast around the walled city of Eastmere, the second hub of the island with its own airfield, docks and the junction where three rail lines meet.
zones.Mirelake Marshes: Swampy lowland on the southern shore of the great northern lake. The lakeside town of Mirelake sits at the end of the Mire Line, and the Meadow Road runs west from it to Millbrook.
zones.Northlake Highlands: Hilly country wrapped around the great northern lake, with bare earth around its outflow and a bridge where the Northlake Road crosses it. The village of Northlake marks the end of the Northern Line.
zones.Sandcrest Desert: The arid heart of the east: open sand, heat and sandstorms. Sandcrest Keep watches over the desert, the Ruins of Ashkar lie on its north-eastern edge, and the Oasis Trading Post is the last stop for supplies before the Blightlands. The Eastern Line and the Desert Road both cross it.
zones.Coral Isles: A scatter of tropical islands far to the south-east of the main island, reached only by sea through Coral Harbor or by air through Gull Island Airstrip. The isles have a small harbour village, a market, a store and the lonely Gull Watchtower.
zones.Ironspine Mountains: A rugged range of grey rock south of the snowfields, riddled with mines and caves. The Frost Line climbs along its western flank on the way to Frosthold.
zones.Frosthold Peaks: The frozen north-west: deep snowfields, blizzards and extreme cold. The remote town of Frosthold is very hard to reach. Frostpass Road is still being built, the Frost Line freezes in extreme winters, and heavy snow can block Frosthold Harbor. The Temple of the Frozen Dawn stands on the eastern side of the snowfields.
zones.Blightlands: The corrupted south-east of the main island: purple, blighted earth and broken rock along the coast. It is one of the two most dangerous regions in the world, with the Blighted Ruins, the rough Blight Camp Village and the Mingal Shrine (Corrupted).
zones.Emberfall Volcano: A volcanic island in the far south-east with a glowing lava crater, ash fields and caves in its flanks. It has no harbour or airstrip of its own; the closest landing is Coral Harbor on the neighbouring isles. Together with the Blightlands it is the end-game region of the world.

places.Aurelia: The walled capital on the southern coast, and the place where every player begins. Inside the walls are Sunspire Palace, the plaza fountain, the Grand Market, The Golden Gull Inn, the Royal Bank, the Adventurers Guild and the Blacksmith, guarded by two watchtowers. Aurelia Central Station, Aurelia Airport and Aurelia Harbor connect it to the rest of the world.
places.Westbrook: A sizeable city on the west side of the island, on the edge of the Wildwood. It is the end of the Western Line and the start of the Frost Line north to Frosthold.
places.Eastmere: The walled eastern city and the island's second transport hub: Eastmere Junction joins the Eastern, Northern and Mire lines, and the city has its own airfield and docks.
places.Frosthold: A small, isolated town in the north-western snowfields. Reaching it is a journey: the road there is unfinished, the Frost Line stops in extreme winters and heavy snow can close the harbour.
places.Mirelake: A lakeside town on the southern shore of the great northern lake, served by the Mire Line and joined to Millbrook by the Meadow Road.
places.Seabreeze: A beach town on the south-western coast, connected to the capital by the Coast Road.
places.Millbrook: A farming village in the northern meadows, surrounded by windmills. Frostpass Road toward Frosthold starts here.
places.Northlake: A village on the far side of the great northern lake, at the end of the Northern Line.
places.Blight Camp Village: A rough settlement of camps on the edge of the Blightlands, reached by the road from the Oasis Trading Post.
places.Sunspire Palace: The royal palace at the heart of Aurelia.
places.Sandcrest Keep: A desert fortress standing over the Sandcrest Desert, beside Sandcrest Station on the Eastern Line.
places.Temple of the Frozen Dawn: A remote shrine on the eastern side of the Frosthold snowfields.
places.Ruins of Ashkar: Old ruins on the north-eastern edge of the Sandcrest Desert, close to Eastmere.
places.Blighted Ruins: Crumbling ruins deep in the Blightlands.
places.Mingal Shrine (Corrupted): A shrine on the east side of the Blightlands, consumed by the corruption.
places.Lonely Light: A lighthouse on a tiny islet alone in the southern sea.
places.Gull Watchtower: A watchtower on a small islet among the Coral Isles.
places.Oasis Trading Post: A desert trading post beside Sandcrest Station; the road to Blight Camp Village starts here.
places.Coral Market: The market of the Coral Isles harbour village.
places.Gull Island Store: A small store on Gull Island, near the airstrip.
places.Ironspine Mine: A mine in the western Ironspine Mountains.
places.Deepvein Mine: A mine in the western Ironspine Mountains, just north of Ironspine Mine.
places.Frostbite Mine: A mine in the north-eastern Ironspine Mountains, next to Icefang Cave.
places.Echo Cave: A cave in the heart of the Ironspine Mountains.
places.Icefang Cave: A cave at the cold northern edge of the Ironspine Mountains, beside Frostbite Mine.
places.Cinder Cave: A cave on the southern slopes of the Emberfall Volcano.
places.Magma Rift Cave: A cave on the eastern slopes of the Emberfall Volcano.
places.Road Builders Camp: The construction crew's camp at the current end of Frostpass Road.
